name: Physical 100: Sweden
overview: Physical 100: Sweden brings together some of Sweden’s most accomplished athletes, as well as firefighters, construction workers, gym rats, military professionals and celebrities. Amongst the 100 competitors fighting for the top spot are global swimming icons Sarah Sjöström and Therese Alshammar, UFC legend Alexander “The Mauler” Gustafsson, Olympic alpine champion André Myhrer, multitalented artist Daniel Adams-Ray, 7-time parkour World Cup winner Miranda Tibbling, boxing star Mikaela Laurén, elite calisthenics athletes Simon Imhäuser and Malin Migdal Flefil, actor Björn Bengtsson, and influencers Hissy Elhissy and Ludwig Blomqvist.
